entities.name: PMID:25443718
observations: In PC12 cells, S43126 reduced proliferation by more than 50%, increased cell death by more than 40%, increased apoptotic bodies, and increased intracellular ROS by more than 2.5-fold versus vehicle.

N-acetylcysteine attenuated S43126-associated ROS and downstream effects; ERK, JNK, and p38 MAPK inhibitors reduced antiproliferative activity; caspases 3, 8, and 9 were activated and z-VAD-fmk ameliorated cell death and proliferation effects.
The authors characterized ROS, stress-activated MAPKs, and caspases as partly mediating S43126 effects; evidence is pharmacologic and contributory rather than exclusive or definitive pathway proof.

entities.name: S43126
observations: Novel imidazoline compound that induced antiproliferative and cell-death effects in PC12 cells in PMID:25443718.

entities.name: PC12 cells
observations: Rat pheochromocytoma-derived PC12 cells were used to assess S43126-induced proliferation loss, cell death, ROS, MAPK signaling, and caspase activation.

entities.name: S43126 ROS contribution
observations: In PC12 cells, S43126 increased intracellular ROS by more than 2.5-fold; N-acetylcysteine significantly reduced the ROS increase and downstream effects, supporting partial ROS mediation.

entities.name: S43126 MAPK contribution
observations: Inhibitors of ERK, JNK, and p38 MAPK reduced S43126-induced antiproliferative activity in PC12 cells, supporting functional MAPK involvement; target selectivity and direct kinase activation were not fully established in the available record.

entities.name: S43126 caspase contribution
observations: S43126 time-dependently activated caspases 3, 8, and 9; pan-caspase inhibitor z-VAD-fmk ameliorated cell death and proliferation effects, supporting partial caspase mediation without individual-caspase loss-of-function proof.
